name: Mixed Lentil Adai with Spinach
ingredients: ¼ cup each chana dal, toor dal and split yellow moong dal
¼ tsp hing (check gluten-free label if needed)
steps: Rinse dals and rice. Soak with dried chilli for 3–4 hours, then drain.
Grind coarsely with cumin, hing, salt and enough water to make a thick spreadable batter.
Stir in spinach and coriander. Rest 5 minutes.
Heat a tawa, brush with oil and spread a ladle of batter into a thick 15 cm disc. Make a small hole in the centre for even cooking.
Cook 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Repeat with remaining batter.
note: Naturally vegan when cooked with oil. Soaking time is additional to the active preparation estimate.
